collection_title: Floods, droughts and design rainfall in two data-sparse Nigerian basins
title: Study areas
description: Outline of the Sokoto-Rima basin (HydroBASINS, simplified to about 1 km) and the Lower Niger-Benue analysis box.

collection_title: Floods, droughts and design rainfall in two data-sparse Nigerian basins
title: CHIRPS design rainfall per 0.25-degree cell, 1985–2014
description: Return levels of annual maximum daily rainfall (Rx1day, mm) for 2, 10, 25, 50 and 100 years, from a GEV fit by L-moments to CHIRPS 1985–2014, for each 0.25-degree cell of the two study areas. Satellite rainfall estimates, not gauge measurements.

collection_title: Water storage in the Lake Chad basin from GRACE and GRACE-FO
title: Study areas
description: The HydroBASINS level-3 unit that contains Lake Chad (main study area) and a level-4 unit west of the lake (sensitivity test).

collection_title: Water storage in the Lake Chad basin from GRACE and GRACE-FO
title: Total water storage trend per 1-degree cell
description: Straight-line trend of total water storage (mm per year) in each 1-degree GRACE/GRACE-FO cell (COST-G solution). A trend over the whole record; the study reports that the record changes little until about 2018 and then rises, so one straight line is a simplification.

collection_title: Surface urban heat island and distance to vegetation in Lagos State
title: LGA boundaries with heat and vegetation attributes
description: The 20 LGAs of Lagos State with area, modelled population, mean Landsat and MODIS land surface temperature, NDVI, NDBI, terrain and Getis-Ord hot-spot statistics, from the export recorded in the layer's own `period` field. Population is a WorldPop model estimate, not a census count.

collection_title: Urban sealing and the shallow water table of the Lekki–Epe barrier, Lagos
title: Recharge-potential index, 1986–1996 imagery
description: Recharge-potential index on a 30 m grid (UTM 31N) from Landsat 5 TM November–March composites of 1986–1996, with the study's sensor and rainfall corrections. A relative score between 0 and 1.

collection_title: Urban sealing and the shallow water table of the Lekki–Epe barrier, Lagos
title: Recharge-potential index, 2023–2024 imagery
description: Recharge-potential index on a 30 m grid (UTM 31N) from Sentinel-2 L2A, 1 November 2023 to 31 March 2024. A relative score between 0 and 1.

collection_title: Travel time to health facilities in Mozambique
title: District travel time to public-sector facilities, 2020
description: The 159 districts with WorldPop 2020 population and, for the public-sector facility list of Maina et al. (2019) (list A), the share of residents over 60 and 120 minutes from a facility and the median travel time in minutes, by motorized and walking travel (Malaria Atlas Project friction surfaces, 2020). `compared` marks the districts used in the study's comparisons. Outlines simplified by the study.

collection_title: Travel time to health facilities in Mozambique
title: Health facilities, public-sector list and WHO HeRAMS
description: Facility points of list A (public-sector facilities, Maina et al., 2019) and list H (WHO HeRAMS 2022–2024 for Cabo Delgado, Nampula and Zambézia, with reported functioning and quarter), with the study's flags for position checks and use.

collection_title: Travel time to health facilities in Mozambique
title: Health facilities from OpenStreetMap
description: Facility points of list B, from the HOT OpenStreetMap export of Mozambique's health facilities accessed by the study on 19 November 2026, with the study's flags. Licensed under the ODbL 1.0, © OpenStreetMap contributors.
